# Odd q < 2000 for which Table A.1 of J. Seberry and M. Yamada, "Hadamard matrices, sequences, and block designs"
# (Contemporary Design Theory, Wiley, 1992, pp. 431-560) records four Williamson-type matrices of order q
# (column t blank, a construction given). Parsed from the text of the table and corrected by hand where the
# extraction merged columns (q = 421-429, 513-521, 605-613, 697-705, 789). Entries with t = 3 (only 8-Williamson
# matrices, or Williamson-type matrices of order 2q) and blank entries are left out.
# 1999 was removed on October 17: Table A.1 gives it as w#p (8-Williamson matrices only).
